source.path: Sony Playstation 2/Metal Gear Solid 3_ Snake Eater.pdf

evidence.On foot/Left stick: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram, leader to left stick: left analog stick - Normal View: Move around
evidence.On foot/Up/Down/Left/Right: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram, leader to D-pad: Directional button - Normal View: Move in Stalking mode
evidence.On foot/Right stick: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram, leader to right stick: right analog stick - Change camera angle.
evidence.On foot/R3: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: R3 button when pushed - Lock the camera in the direction the right analog stick is pressed. Press again to unlock.
evidence.On foot/L3: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: L3 button when pushed - When grabbing enemy: Interrogate enemy
evidence.On foot/L1: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: L1 button - Aim button. When holding a weapon: Lock in the direction the weapon is pointed
evidence.On foot/R1: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: R1 button - First Person View button. Change Snake's view; pdf12 (printed 20): press and hold the R1 button to switch the camera view to Snake's perspective
evidence.On foot/L2: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: L2 button - Item Window button. Normal View: Select, equip, and unequip items
evidence.On foot/R2: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: R2 button - Weapon Window button. Normal View: Select, equip and unequip weapons; pdf23 (printed 42): Tactical Reload - quickly pressing the R2 button twice
evidence.On foot/L2+R2: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: L2 button and R2 button simultaneously - Normal View: Stand on tiptoes
evidence.On foot/Square: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram, leader to Square: Weapon button. Use the currently equipped weapon.
evidence.On foot/Circle: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram, leader to Circle: Punch button, CQC button, Enter button. Punch, use CQC, knock on walls (when pressed against one).
evidence.On foot/Triangle: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram, leader to Triangle: Action button. Climb trees, Open lockers, go up/down ladders, climb onto platforms, hang, etc.
evidence.On foot/Cross: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram, leader to Cross: Crawl button, Cancel button. Switch stance between standing, crouching, and crawling.; pdf12 (printed 21): While running, press the Cross button to execute a rolling maneuver.
evidence.On foot/Select: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: SELECT button - Enter Radio Mode.
evidence.On foot/Start: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: START button - Enter the Survival Viewer.
evidence.First person/Left stick: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: left analog stick - First Person View: Look around; pdf12 (printed 20): Use the left analog stick (or directional button) to change the direction Snake is looking.
evidence.First person/Up/Down/Left/Right: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: Directional button - First Person View: Look around
evidence.First person/L1: pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: L1 button - First Person View: Shoulder aim; pdf13 (printed 23): pressing the Aim button (L1 button) allows Snake to aim more precisely with some weapons.
evidence.First person/R1: pdf12 (printed 20): press and hold the R1 button to switch the camera view to Snake's perspective
evidence.First person/L2: pdf13 (printed 22) figure: L2: Shift one step left; pdf12 (printed 20): Press the L2 or R2 button to shift one step to the left or right.
evidence.First person/R2: pdf13 (printed 22) figure: R2: Shift one step right; pdf12 (printed 20): Press the L2 or R2 button to shift one step to the left or right.
evidence.First person/L2+R2: pdf12 (printed 20): Press the L2 and R2 buttons at the same time to stand on tiptoes.; pdf13 (printed 22) figure: L2 + R2 simultaneously: Stand on tiptoes
evidence.First person/Square: pdf12 (printed 20): you can make him use the currently equipped weapon by pressing the Square button.; pdf13 (printed 23): press the Square button to aim the weapon, and release the button to fire.
evidence.Corner view/Left stick: pdf12 (printed 20): Pressing and holding the left analog stick (or directional button) towards a tree or wall causes Snake to press himself against that surface.
evidence.Corner view/Right stick: pdf12 (printed 20): The camera can be pointed in different directions using the right analog stick.
evidence.Corner view/L2/R2: pdf13 (printed 22): When Snake is pressed against trees and walls and Corner View is active, press the L2/R2 button to peek around the corner to the left or right.; While pressed, use the L2/R2 button to move along the surface.; pdf3 (printed 3) diagram: L2 and R2 - Corner/First Person View: Peek
evidence.Corner view/Circle: pdf13 (printed 22): While pressed against a tree or wall, press the Circle button to knock on the surface and make a noise.
evidence.Corner view/Square: pdf23 (printed 42) Jumpout Shots: in Corner View, equip a gun and press the Square button to jump out from around the corner and point the gun.
evidence.Hanging/Left stick: pdf12 (printed 21) Controls while Hanging: Left analog stick or L2/R2 button: Move left/right
evidence.Hanging/L2/R2: pdf12 (printed 21) Controls while Hanging: Left analog stick or L2/R2 button: Move left/right
evidence.Hanging/Triangle: pdf12 (printed 21) Controls while Hanging: Triangle button: Return to the top of the branch/inside of the railing
evidence.Hanging/Square: pdf12 (printed 21) Controls while Hanging: Square button: Aim/fire the currently equipped weapon
evidence.Hanging/Cross: pdf12 (printed 21) Controls while Hanging: Cross button: Let go and drop down
evidence.Hanging/L2+R2: pdf12 (printed 21) Controls while Hanging: L2 button + R2 button: Do a pull-up
evidence.Swimming/Cross: pdf14 (printed 25) In shallow water: Cross button - Submerge; In deep water: Cross button - Submerge underwater
evidence.Swimming/Left stick+Cross: pdf14 (printed 25) In shallow water: left analog stick + Cross button - Dive in
evidence.Swimming/Triangle: pdf14 (printed 25) In deep water: Triangle button - Climb onto dry land (only if land is no more than about 2 feet above the water)
evidence.Swimming/Circle: pdf14 (printed 25) In deep water: Circle button - Swing torch (when torch is equipped)
evidence.Underwater/Left stick: pdf14 (printed 25) Underwater: left analog stick - Change direction
evidence.Underwater/Triangle: pdf14 (printed 25) Underwater: Triangle button - Quick surface button (pressing it repeatedly will make Snake swim toward the surface)
evidence.Underwater/Cross/Circle: pdf14 (printed 25) Underwater: Cross button - Move forward; press repeatedly to accelerate; Circle button - Move forward; press repeatedly to accelerate
evidence.Underwater/Right stick: pdf14 (printed 25) Underwater: right analog stick - Change the camera angle
evidence.Underwater/R3: pdf14 (printed 25) Underwater: Press the R3 button to fix the camera angle
